title: Google Search Result Click-Through Rates
takeaway: Over 70% of local searches result in a purchase.

data.label: Local Search Click-Through Rate
data.evidence: Studies show that over 70% of local searches result in a purchase.

narration: Local SEO is critical for small businesses because a significant portion of local searches lead to a purchase.  Google prioritizes local results, and optimizing your online presence can dramatically increase your chances of capturing those valuable leads.  It's a key driver of revenue for local businesses.
